You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I incorrectly interpreted "negatively affect... through" as asking only for the sign of the mediator's effect ($gwet \to xevu$), ignoring the sign of the total effect of the treatment on the mediator ($yomx \to gwet$). The indirect effect is the product of the two path coefficients: $(P(gwet|yomx) - P(gwet|\neg yomx)) \times (P(xevu|yomx, gwet) - P(xevu|\neg yomx, gwet))$. Since $yomx$ reduces the probability of $gwet$ (negative effect) and $gwet$ increases the probability of $xevu$ (positive effect), the product is negative. Next time, I will explicitly calculate both the treatment-on-the-mediator effect and the mediator-on-the-outcome effect, multiply their signs, and conclude based on the sign of this product.
